messages:
marco: Heads-up — planning to run terraform apply for the v2-routing release tonight during the 23:00 UTC change window. Plan looks clean but includes an IAM policy tweak for the rds-access role.
jen: paste the plan diff? want to eyeball the IAM change.
marco: quick snippet from the plan:
```
# module/network.aws_iam_role.rds_access will be updated in-place
~ assume_role_policy: json -> json (modified)
+ statement 2: allow sts:AssumeRole for account: 123456789012:role/infra-sa
```
sam: That cross-account assume looks sensitive. @isaac can you vet?
isaac: Reviewing now. One request: pin the aws-iam module to a specific tag in versions.tf (3.1.2) before apply to avoid drift on module changes.
marco: Good catch — updated versions.tf and re-ran `terraform plan`. State lock confirmed on s3 backend.
deploy-bot: :gear: deploy scheduled by marco for 2025-06-23T23:00:00Z (change window: 23:00-23:30 UTC). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/iam-policy-change
toni: Add a pre-change snapshot step for DBs and a quick smoke test for auth flows. Also add rollback instructions in the runbook.
jen: Product side: do we need to call out anything in release notes? @lia
lia: Product here — infra-only change, no feature flag. I'm fine as long as we note a short auth propagation window (~30s). I'll add a short line in release notes.
marco: Plan says no instance replacements, just policy update. Expect no downtime. Will run apply with monitoring and tag the commit: `inference-service/2025-06-23-iamv2`.
isaac: Security approves provided the runbook includes a clear revert of the assume_role_policy to the prior JSON (we'll store the old policy blob in the ticket).
marco: Will capture previous policy and attach to the ticket before apply. Also will create an infra branch with pinned module version.
sam: I'll be on pager during the window. If we see auth errors or latency > 2x, we rollback.
deploy-bot: :rocket: apply started by marco at 2025-06-23T23:00:15Z
marco: `terraform apply -var-file=prod.tfvars -auto-approve` — apply completed, only the iam policy updated. Monitoring auth logs now. :eyes:
lia: Quick smoke pass completed from app servers — auth flows OK. :white_check_mark:
isaac: Confirming audit trail and recording module pin 3.1.2 in infra repo. Closing security review ticket.
marco: Thanks everyone. I'll post the short release note and close this thread once docs are updated. :thumbsup:
